fact_text: Property cannot be sold quickly at a known price, whereas listed shares can be sold at the prevailing market price almost at once; the analyst saw this liquidity as a key advantage of equity ownership.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistani property deals often lack a public transaction record; the analyst reported that brokers sometimes kept part of the settlement or steered buyers into overpriced deals.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A DHA plot bought in 2014 for about 40 lakh was sold roughly six years later for about 53 lakh, a return the analyst described as a lesson in the property market's opacity.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Listed Pakistani companies pay dividends at regular intervals, such as quarterly or six-monthly, so a long-term shareholder receives cash income while still holding the shares.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst viewed a sharp market fall as a good time to reinvest in quality businesses rather than sell into the drop; selling in a downturn turns a temporary fall into a realised loss.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Drawing on The Intelligent Investor, the analyst separated a trader who reacts to price moves from an investor who owns a good business and sells only when the price reaches fair value.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Businesses with lumpy, order-driven revenue can keep a separate low-risk portfolio of mutual funds and dividend stocks to cover salaries and running costs during slow order periods.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A mutual fund portfolio can be split into a growth-stock portion, a dividend-stock portion and a money-market portion, and funds span low, medium and high risk levels.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst preferred owning shares in established businesses to starting a new one, since shares can be sold with a click and a new venture would absorb the owner's time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'From Property Broker Disasters to Stock Market Success' (YouTube transcript, undated)
